6355.note_text: The term “pattern” is used in legal metrology with the same meaning as “type”; below only the term “type” is used. [VIML, 2.5]

6353.note_text: systematic examination and testing of the performance of one or more samples of an identified type of measuring instrument against documented requirements, the results of which are contained in the evaluation report, in order to determine whether the type may be approved
